components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call to action; pill-shaped, brightens and lifts on hover, presses on click.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--color-primary, #0B3D91); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #FFFFFF); transition: filter 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0B3D91); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action that must not compete with the primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E2E6EC); background: var(--color-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--color-foreground, #0F172A); transition: border-color 0.3s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: rgb(15 23 42 / 0.4); }

components.name: Featured Badge
components.description: Marks a featured vehicle; sits top-left over the card photo.
components.css: .ds-badge-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; background: var(--color-accent, #F59E0B); color: var(--color-accent-foreground, #1F1300); }

components.name: Vehicle Card
components.description: Signature listing card: photo, spec row, and a price/arrow footer; the model title is the sole focus target, extended over the whole card.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; } .ds-card-photo { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4/3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: rgb(15 23 42 / 0.05); } .ds-card-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 1s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-photo img { transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; padding-top: 1.25rem; } .ds-eyebrow { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #5B6474); } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Playfair Display', serif); font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0.5rem; color: var(--color-foreground, #0F172A); } .ds-card-specs { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #5B6474); font-size: 0.875rem; margin: 1rem 0 1.25rem; } .ds-card-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E2E6EC); padding-top: 1rem; margin-top: auto; } .ds-card-price { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--color-foreground, #0F172A); } .ds-card-arrow { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E2E6EC); transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-arrow { background: var(--color-primary, #0B3D91); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #FFFFFF); border-color: transparent; transform: rotate(45deg); }

components.name: Text Input

components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E2E6EC); background: var(--color-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--color-foreground, #0F172A); font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(91 100 116 / 0.7); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary, #0B3D91); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(11 61 145 / 0.2); }

narrative.overview: Vitrine Auto is not one dealership's look — it's a stage built to make any dealership feel like a real showroom the moment a client's colors and type are dropped in. Every reskin (from demo's blue-and-amber daylight dealership to premium-example's black-and-gold boutique) inherits the same underlying grammar: a cinematic full-bleed hero with a slow Ken Burns pull-back or ambient drifting light, staggered fade-up entrances, generous whitespace, and interactive surfaces that respond with confidence — brightening, lifting, rotating — the instant a visitor's cursor arrives. Nothing sits static out of laziness; stillness is the resting state, and motion is always a direct reply to attention or interaction. The aspiration is a premium-automotive-brand level of restraint and polish — full-bleed photography, unhurried pacing, generous negative space — while keeping today's structure, copy, and behavior untouched. That bar is not yet fully reached everywhere in the codebase; closing the gap is refinement work, not a rebuild.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed cinematic hero (photo Ken Burns pull-back, or ambient drifting color blobs + faint grid when no photo exists)
Staggered fade-up entrance choreography on hero copy and on every section as it enters the viewport
Flat-at-rest surfaces; shadow and lift appear only as a direct response to hover/focus
Pill-shaped buttons by default (fully reskinnable to the theme's base radius instead)
Editorial serif display type as an optional register on top of a confident sans-serif base
A single reserved utility color (WhatsApp green) that is never treated as a brand color

rules.name: The One Stage, Many Lights Rule
rules.body: No component may hardcode a hex value belonging to one tenant. If a color needs to appear, it names a role (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, …) and lets the active tenant's CSS variables answer.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-a-Register Rule
rules.body: headingFont is optional per tenant. No component may assume a serif is loaded; the fallback (bold sans, tighter tracking) must look intentional on its own, not like a missing font.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: A shadow with no hover, focus, or fixed-position justification is a defect, not a style choice — add elevation only as a state response.

rules.name: The Pill-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Buttons read as pills unless a tenant deliberately asks for "rounded"; this is the strongest single silhouette cue that ties every reskin back to the same system.

dos: Do resolve every color, radius, and button shape through the theme's CSS custom properties — never a literal hex or a hardcoded rounded-lg.
Do treat shadow as a response to hover, focus, or genuine floating position — not a resting decoration.
Do keep every animation degrading gracefully: instantly visible without JS, instant without motion preference.
Do keep the WhatsApp green scoped to WhatsApp contact affordances only.
donts: Don't give a card, section, or header a resting shadow it hasn't earned through interaction or fixed positioning.
Don't assume a serif headingFont is present — the bold-sans fallback must look deliberate.
Don't add a second focusable link/button inside a VehicleCard; the whole-card link is the only target.
Don't let a component read correctly for one tenant's palette and break for another's — that's a token leak, not a style variance.
